projects.title: AI Resume Analyzer
projects.tagline: Automated ATS Evaluation & NLP Matching Engine
projects.summary: Developed an AI-powered automated resume evaluation engine that extracts candidate information from PDFs using PyPDF2 and spaCy, compares it against job descriptions using TF-IDF and cosine similarity, and produces ATS compatibility scores with keyword gap reports.
projects.problemStatement: Manual candidate screening is heavily time-consuming, prone to human inconsistency, and delays talent acquisition cycles when hiring managers must sift through hundreds of unstructured PDF resumes.
objectives: Automate unstructured PDF resume text extraction and normalization using PyPDF2 and spaCy.
Compute semantic ATS compatibility match scores via TF-IDF vectorization and cosine similarity.
Generate detailed keyword gap analysis reports identifying missing competencies.
Deliver rapid processing speeds under two seconds per document.
keyFeatures: Automated PDF resume text extraction and clean tokenization
Named Entity Recognition (NER) and domain skill classification
TF-IDF vector matching against job descriptions
Cosine similarity ATS compatibility percentage calculation
Detailed keyword deficiency and recommendations report
Modular Flask REST API ready for frontend dashboard integration

workflow.title: Document Ingestion
workflow.detail: Applicant uploads resume in PDF format; PyPDF2 extracts raw character stream and normalizes whitespace.

workflow.title: NLP Preprocessing
workflow.detail: spaCy pipeline executes stop-word removal, lemmatization, and technical entity identification.

workflow.title: Vector Transformation
workflow.detail: TF-IDF vectorizer converts resume content and target job description into mathematical term-frequency vectors.

workflow.title: Cosine Similarity Scoring
workflow.detail: Computes directional angular similarity between vectors to determine overall ATS compatibility percentage.

workflow.title: Report & Recommendation
workflow.detail: Identifies missing high-impact keywords and outputs structured JSON payload with candidate suitability insights.

projects.implementationOverview: The application is built in Python with a Flask microservice layer. The ingestion engine utilizes PyPDF2 to parse multi-page PDFs, feeding cleansed text into a spaCy NLP pipeline for tokenization and keyword extraction. Scikit-learn's TfidfVectorizer transforms both the applicant resume and target job description into vector space representations, where cosine similarity measures alignment. Analytical data is organized using Pandas to format output scores, matching matrices, and missing keyword breakdowns.
projects.reportedResults: Resume reports 88% matching accuracy and processing in under two seconds per document. Resume reports a 70% reduction in manual candidate screening time.

projects.title: E-Commerce Sales & Customer Analytics
projects.tagline: Scalable Relational Database & Advanced SQL Business Intelligence
projects.summary: Designed a normalized MySQL database schema handling over 100,000 transaction records to analyze customer lifetime value, revenue trends, and shopping behavior through advanced SQL queries, window functions, and multi-table aggregations.
projects.problemStatement: Large volume e-commerce transaction data scattered across unstructured records resulted in slow manual reporting, delayed revenue visibility, and inefficient query execution for commercial decision-makers.
objectives: Architect a normalized 3NF relational database schema in MySQL for high data integrity.
Ingest and manage over 100,000 transaction records efficiently.
Formulate optimized queries using window functions (RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD/LAG) and CTEs.
Dramatically reduce recurring reporting latency and boost query execution efficiency.
keyFeatures: Normalized 3NF relational schema (Customers, Orders, OrderItems, Products, Payments)
Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) calculation and multi-tiered customer segmentation
Time-series monthly and quarterly revenue growth trend calculations
Product performance matrix and inventory turnover velocity analytics
Strategic B-Tree indexing on primary and foreign keys for high query throughput
Modular SQL script repository with parameterized analytical test queries

workflow.title: Schema Normalization
workflow.detail: Eliminated insertion, update, and deletion anomalies by structuring relational entities to 3NF.

workflow.title: Data Population & Indexing
workflow.detail: Imported 100,000+ realistic transaction rows and constructed composite indexes on high-frequency lookup columns.

workflow.title: Advanced Analytical Queries
workflow.detail: Applied window functions (SUM OVER, ROW_NUMBER, LAG) and Common Table Expressions for cohort retention.

workflow.title: Query Plan Optimization
workflow.detail: Profiled query performance using EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE to minimize full table scans.

workflow.title: KPI Dashboards & Reports
workflow.detail: Synthesized commercial KPIs into executive reporting summaries for data-driven strategic planning.

projects.implementationOverview: Designed in MySQL using structured DDL/DML scripts. Tables were decomposed into 3NF with cascading referential integrity constraints. Formulated multi-tier analytical queries using CTEs, window functions like DENSE_RANK() for top-performing product categories, and cumulative window sums for rolling revenue. Applied indexes on customer ID, order date, and product SKU, validated through query execution plans.
projects.reportedResults: Resume reports a 40% reduction in manual reporting time and a 30% improvement in query execution efficiency across 100,000+ transaction records.

projects.title: Rythumitra-360
projects.tagline: Smart Agri-Tech & Farmer Decision Support Ecosystem
projects.summary: Full-stack digital agriculture platform delivering AI-driven crop leaf disease detection, real-time regional mandi market price tracking, localized weather forecasting, and automated crop advisory.
projects.problemStatement: Farmers in agrarian regions experience severe crop losses and market exploitation due to delayed pest/disease diagnosis, unpredictable local weather shifts, and lack of real-time transparency in mandi commodity pricing.
objectives: Provide automated, real-time crop disease identification from leaf images using computer vision and machine learning.
Aggregate localized weather forecasts and agro-meteorological advisories.
Deliver daily mandi crop price tracking across regional APMC agricultural markets.
Build an accessible, mobile-first responsive interface tailored for rural farmers and agronomists.
keyFeatures: Computer vision leaf disease diagnosis using OpenCV image preprocessing and ML models
Dynamic mandi commodity price tracker covering regional agricultural markets
Localized agro-weather alerts, precipitation forecasts, and spray timing advisories
Fertilizer dosage and crop cycle management recommendations engine
Responsive React.js interface with intuitive touch navigation and visual cues
Lightweight Python Flask REST microservice with structured MySQL storage

workflow.title: Capture & Upload
workflow.detail: Farmer snaps a crop leaf photograph or selects target crop commodity and market district.

workflow.title: Image Preprocessing
workflow.detail: OpenCV pipeline standardizes resolution, adjusts contrast, and isolates diseased foliar regions.

workflow.title: ML Model Inference
workflow.detail: Trained classification model evaluates foliar symptoms to determine disease class and confidence score.

workflow.title: Market & Weather Ingestion
workflow.detail: Fetches current day APMC mandi spot rates and hyper-local precipitation forecasts via REST endpoints.

workflow.title: Actionable 360 Advisory
workflow.detail: Presents step-by-step organic/chemical treatment remedies, fertilizer schedules, and optimal selling markets.

projects.implementationOverview: Rythumitra-360 is engineered as an integrated Agri-Tech solution. The frontend is built in React.js with mobile-optimized Bootstrap 5 components. The backend uses Python Flask to expose RESTful APIs for image inference, weather aggregation, and market pricing. Image analysis combines OpenCV with ML classification algorithms to detect foliar crop diseases, while MySQL maintains historical mandi price trends, user query histories, and agronomic guidelines.
projects.reportedResults: Demonstrated high-accuracy disease detection across staple crops (paddy, cotton, chilli), centralized regional mandi price tracking, and sub-second API response times across mobile networks.
